summary: Collect bricks and make your path to success in the bridge race runner game.
description:
Build your path to success!

Build bridges to survive! Collect the bricks or you will fall! Dodge obstacles to reach the finish line! A fun, relaxing runner game with a satisfying level end challenge. Brick Builder 3D is the ultimate fusion of classic brick game and the thrill of a runner game! This addictive runner game seamlessly combines the timeless fun of brick stacking with the excitement of a fast-paced runner. Test your reflexes as you sprint through challenging levels, collecting bricks, power-ups, and dodging obstacles. Construct your way to victory by strategically placing bricks and building epic structures while keeping pace in this unique gaming experience. Brick Builder 3D offers a fresh twist on two beloved gaming genres, ensuring hours of endless fun and excitement.
